asset.name: Hyperliquid

score_rationales.supply: HYPE is capped at 1B with ~238.4M circulating (~24.8% of max) and ~962.3M total on CoinGecko, so most supply is still non-circulating—especially the 23.8% core-contributor tranche with multi-year vesting—implying years of potential sell pressure even though allocation is community-heavy and has no VC bucket. Third-party vesting trackers report discretionary monthly claims far below the theoretical vesting ceiling and highlight large unclaimed balances in vesting wallets, while staking uses short locks and a 7-day unstaking queue and protocol revenue funds buybacks/burns, partially offsetting emissions; established exchange-reserve trend data for HYPE remains sparse, so reserve flow is treated as neutral rather than bullish.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Hyperliquid’s adoption is backed by DefiLlama-scale depth (~$4.81B TVL as of the 2026-05-01 pipeline snapshot), heavy derivatives usage (e.g., tens of billions in 30d perp volume and ~$7–8B open interest on public dashboards), and strong monetized activity (~$1.9M daily fees, ~$1.6M daily revenue, ~$598M annualized). The score stays in the low-60s because transparent MAU/DAU and integration counts are not consistently evidenced, so usage breadth is inferred mainly from TVL, volume, and fees rather than full user-level telemetry.
